theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Sports Analytics Variant)
core_principles: Tactical Minimalism: Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes or subtle inner glows
Data Clarity: Use high contrast for match scores and statuses

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-white

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6 to p-8 inside match cards.

grids.match_details: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 (Control Room Pattern)

header.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10
header.notes: Ensure body has pt-[header-height] to prevent overlap.

match_card.classes: rounded-2xl bg-[#141415] border border-white/10 p-6 flex flex-col gap-4 relative overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300
match_card.notes: Use purely CSS/Tailwind for card wrapper, avoid Shadcn Card if it restricts flexibility.

status_badge.classes: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
status_badge.live_animation: For live matches, include a w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-green-500 animate-pulse

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-500 text-white hover:bg-emerald-600 rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 text-white hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-colors

hero_background.description: Local CSS radial gradient in dark green and black. No external photo or logo rights are implied.

turkish_translations_guide.home_subtitle: En güncel futbol karşılaşmaları ve canlı skorlar.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST explicitly set hover colors. Example: hover:text-emerald-400.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use transition-all duration-300 ease-out for cards.
motion_and_interactions.live_pulse: Live match badges must have a pulsating green dot using animate-pulse.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements, cards, and key data points MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid="match-card-galatasaray-fenerbahce", data-testid="live-status-badge").

instructions_to_main_agent: Use system fonts. Do not load external photos, fonts, crests or emblems without verified rights.
Use the existing Next.js navigation and Tailwind dark theme.
Lucide dependency icons retain their separate license notices.
Use synthetic fixtures only for automated tests.
Do not add authentication, betting links or payments.
